description: Read sanitized V3 run diagnostics (the current session's runs, checkpoints and context assembly, without model text or credentials) and sign the agent's browser in as a test account of one tier.
skill_summary: Typed, sanitized run diagnostics for the current session, and test-account sign-in per tier.
migration_note: Runs as an ability plugin (plugin.json, requests_v1): the app answers its diagnostics and review requests for the calling session and checks administrator authority. Execution still requires applicable installation, account-tier, agent, membership and session grants.
owner_tier_note: Hard-coded: Administrator abilities work only for an administrator owner and an administrator caller, whatever this list says.
